items.title: Sheryl Bailey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 24, 2023
items.q: I had forgotten that I’d done all that work... there was a ton of Clifford Brown... Clifford Brown to me I think is the most impeccable, perfect soloist.

ctx.x: And another thing that you had mentioned I read, you said transcribing was your bread and butter as far as understanding harmony and improvisation. So you did a lot of that?

Yeah. I did a ton of that, and I wish I had time to do more. But you know I actually didn’t even realize ‘til actually when I was moving my stuff from my New York apartment to the Boston apartment and I just had files that I hadn’t opened for years. And I came across this box of transcription I had done that I had stuff from high school and through my time at Berklee and after. And there were stacks, and there was a ton of Clifford Brown, Dexter Gordon, and Wes — and there was just so — I had forgotten that I’d…
Do you recall when you did all that transcribing if you then — well first of all did you transcribe the chord changes first?
